craftItems.d: Every hide is sorted by hand — stretch marks, grain and thickness checked one by one.
Cut to the hide, not to a template. No two bags of the same model are ever identical.
Critical seams are hand-sewn — saddle stitch, two needles. It doesn't unravel; if it gives, it gives at one point only.
Edges are sanded, burnished, sanded again. Six passes in total.

home.ctaLead: Add bags to your selection as you browse. When you're done, send it to us on WhatsApp in one tap or download it as a PDF.

strips.q: A bag lasts as long as its weakest seam. We sew that seam by hand.
Leather is a living material. The difference between day one and year five isn't a flaw — it's a record.

about.title: Atelier
about.lead: In Istanbul, with a small team.
body: We don't make in large volumes. We work a model for months and shelve it if it isn't right. Every bag in this catalogue is one that passed.
The leather is vegetable-tanned Turkish and Italian hide. It darkens with time and takes on a colour that becomes yours — that isn't a flaw, it's the hide living.
For wholesale and stockist enquiries, build a selection and send it on WhatsApp; we reply the same day.
